Shrimp are natural cleaners that help keep the aquarium tidy by grazing on algae, biofilm, and leftover food. Their constant activity supports a healthy, balanced ecosystem. 🌿 As they move across the glass, plants, and decorations, shrimp gently remove tiny particles and feed on microorganisms. This natural behavior is one of the reasons they are such valuable members of a freshwater aquarium. 🦐🌱 The most important thing? A stable environment. Clean water, healthy biofilm, and consistent parameters help shrimp stay active and thrive.
